title: EplanMcp project binding (binding.json in a project workspace), bindingVersion 1

bindingVersion.description: The binding format. A reader refuses a version it does not know.

project.description: The project key: the project's canonical path, as the Host computes it.

revision.description: Grows by one with every change; plans record it and are refused when it changed.

cabinets.description: The project's cabinets. Slots only so far: layers, values and the mapping to the project structure come with the configuration work (design 4.3).

items.description: One exact pack version, by its pack digest: the SHA-256 of its pack.json canonicalised per RFC 8785. The manifest lists every resource's hash, so this pins the content too.

locks.description: The pack versions the project uses, dependencies included, by pack digest; sorted by id, one version per id. Installing a newer version changes none.

description: One EPLAN project's binding (workspaces\<project>\binding.json): its cabinets, the pack versions it locks by digest, and a revision that grows with every change. Kept in EplanMcp's data folder, never in the project.
